This barley plot is small but it is my own land, and barley does well here in the highlands. I will put a little fertilizer because barley needs it to give a good harvest, but I cannot afford the full package the extension workers recommend, so I will use less. I always spread manure from my animals before ploughing — that is what my family has always done. I will use the seed I saved from last season, as the improved seed is expensive and hard to find at the cooperative in time.
